name: Sakurano Kurimu
source:
A senior at Hekiyou Academy who is also the student council president who is not very mature for her age. She has an extreme sweet tooth and is constantly teased by the other members of the student council for her younger appearance and mannerisms.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Student_Council%27s_Discretion]Wikipedia[/url]]
